name: Topology and owned cleanup
description: Create, inspect, label, signal, and tear down a multi-pane topology without touching unrelated resources.

variants.description: Build a 2x2 fixture from captured refs, run bounded shell workers, introspect it, and remove it by ownership ledger.
setup: Capture the full baseline tree and create a unique run-owned workspace in a temporary directory.
Prepare deterministic bounded workers that identify their pane role and exit on a run-scoped rendezvous token.
exercise: Split only from captured surface refs until the workspace has four surfaces arranged as a 2x2 topology.
Run one fixture worker per surface, inspect the run-owned subtree and resource metadata, rename and flash the workspace, then close child surfaces and the workspace by recorded refs.

assertions.expectation: The run-owned workspace reports exactly four distinct surfaces and all four refs were captured at creation.
Each run-owned surface exposes the expected nonce-tagged role process; no assertion depends on unrelated process data.
The workspace rename is observable before child surfaces and then the workspace disappear in the requested order.
No run-owned process or surface remains and the baseline tree outside the run ownership set is byte-for-byte equivalent.

cleanup: Signal any surviving fixture worker, then close only remaining resources in the ownership ledger.
Remove the temporary directory and fail the eval if any unrelated topology changed.
